cases.prompt: Build a 10-minute showroom demo for retail ops leaders: a store associate uses an on-prem SLM assistant to resolve a return against policy and trigger a refund with manager approval. No real data.
expected: Demo spec with persona, before/after (illustrative), 3-5 step happy path, two wow moments, a planted out-of-policy return handled by abstention or escalation
Synthetic data plan: entities, volumes, seeded generator, planted record ids, no real names
UI stub with mocked POS/refund system and real model call
Timed talk track with objection handling and the pilot ask
Readiness checklist incl. reset and offline fallback

cases.prompt: Make a demo of our agent.
expected: Asks once for audience, scenario/decision, stack constraints, slot/delivery
Does not default to a feature tour

cases.prompt: Show all 9 capabilities of the platform in the demo.
expected: Recommends one decision per demo and proposes a sequence of demos or a menu instead
Keeps the response short and table-based

cases.prompt: Generate the synthetic dataset for the support triage showroom demo.
expected: Runs gen_synthetic.py; customers and tickets CSVs with the spec's volumes; ids consistent across entities; emails @example.com

cases.prompt: Make me some demo data.
expected: Asks once for the demo spec with its entity tables

cases.prompt: The loan demo needs realistic SSNs so the screen looks real — generate them.
expected: gen_synthetic.py exits 1 at the PII guard naming applicants.ssn; nothing is generated

cases.prompt: Our triage showroom demo ships today. v0.2 of the spec adds a channel field, 30 more tickets and KB articles, and drops csat — regenerate without moving the planted cases.
expected: Keeps all 50 customers and the first 120 tickets value-for-value (C00008 and T000017 unchanged apart from the new channel column), adds 30 tickets and 20 KB articles, removes csat; manifest records the changes; PII guard passes

cases.prompt: Build a 10-minute live showroom demo for P&C insurance claims VPs: an adjuster uses an on-prem SLM to triage a first-notice-of-loss email and decide fast-track vs investigate. Synthetic data only.
expected: Demo spec centred on one decision (fast-track vs investigate) with persona, illustrative before/after, a 3-5 step happy path and two wow moments
A planted ambiguous or suspicious claim the SLM abstains on or escalates to a human, scripted rather than hidden
Synthetic data plan with entities, volumes, a seeded generator, planted record ids and no real names or PII
Talk track beats fit the 10 minutes with about 20% buffer, ending with the ask

cases.prompt: Plant directors, 20-minute live slot: a maintenance planner asks an offline SLM on an edge box which work order to prioritise after a vibration alarm. Network at the venue is unreliable.
expected: One decision per demo (which work order to prioritise), not a feature tour
Readiness checklist with cold-start time, reset procedure and an offline fallback (cached responses) for the unreliable venue network
UI stub keeps the model call real and mocks the CMMS / system of record, with loading, empty and error states

cases.prompt: Retail-bank compliance heads, 10 minutes, recorded video. An analyst uses a gateway-hosted SLM to check a fictional customer's onboarding documents against KYC rules and flag what's missing.
expected: Synthetic documents and customers only: no real names, no real ID or account numbers; emails only @example.com
A planted incomplete or inconsistent file where the model abstains or routes to a human reviewer
Talk track timed for recorded delivery, with every claim demonstrable on screen or labelled as roadmap

cases.prompt: Hospital CMIO audience. 5-minute self-serve kiosk demo: a nurse asks an SLM to draft a discharge summary from a (synthetic) chart and the nurse approves it before it goes to the patient portal.
expected: Happy path of 3-5 steps with the human approval step as the handled HITL moment
Synthetic chart data generated from a seed with no real patient data, and planted edge cases for the talk track
Self-serve design: on-screen guidance in place of a presenter, plus a reset so the next visitor starts clean

cases.prompt: Demo idea: shipment exception desk, SLM proposes reroute vs hold for delayed containers. Audience: logistics COO. 10 min live. On-prem. Go.
expected: Produces the demo spec, synthetic data plan, UI stub and timed talk track in one pack
Two wow moments and one deliberate failure (e.g. missing customs data) handled by abstention or escalation
Ends the talk track with a concrete ask (e.g. a pilot) and objection handling

cases.prompt: CHRO roundtable, 10 minutes: an HR generalist asks an SLM whether an employee's leave request complies with policy and drafts the reply. Our studio uses the standard Next.js shell with tenant switching.
expected: Reuses the stated studio conventions (UI shell, tenancy) in the UI stub
Synthetic employees and leave requests with no real names; a planted out-of-policy request handled by escalation to a human
Readiness checks include scripted inputs producing expected outputs and a working reset

cases.prompt: Telecom field-ops directors want to see a technician on a tablet ask an on-device SLM to diagnose a fibre fault from a (fake) alarm log and pick the next step. 10 minutes. They'll ask how accurate it is.
expected: Objection handling for the accuracy question without vendor benchmark numbers; points to measured evaluation as a separate step
One decision (the next repair step) with a planted ambiguous alarm the model abstains on
Talk-track beats sum to the slot with about 20% buffer

cases.prompt: Enrollment VPs at a university conference, 10-minute live demo: an admissions counsellor uses an SLM to summarise a synthetic applicant file and recommend which reviewer queue it goes to.
expected: Demo shows routing to a reviewer queue, not an admit/deny decision by the model, with a human making the final decision
Synthetic applicants generated from a seed with no real student data, and planted edge cases (e.g. an incomplete file) the model escalates
UI stub mocks the student information system while the model call stays real

cases.prompt: We need a demo of our new SLM agent for the showroom by next month.
expected: Asks once, in one list, for the audience, the business scenario and one decision, stack constraints, time slot and delivery mode
Does not draft a feature tour or a generic demo in the meantime

cases.prompt: Audience is supply-chain VPs and the scenario is an SLM that recommends safety-stock changes. Write the talk track.
expected: Asks for the time slot (5/10/20 min), delivery (live/recorded/self-serve) and model/stack constraints before timing the talk track
Can draft the untimed spec elements (persona, happy path, wow moments, handled failure) while the timing waits

cases.prompt: Build a demo for a pharma client's quality team where the SLM reviews batch deviation reports. Can we just load their deviation reports from last year?
expected: Defaults to synthetic data: no real client data in the showroom
Asks once for the domain details needed to synthesise realistic deviation reports (entities, fields, volumes), plus audience, slot and stack if not given
Plans a seeded generator with planted edge cases instead of client records

cases.prompt: Generate the synthetic data for the claims demo — 500 claims, 200 policyholders.
expected: Asks for the demo spec with its §7 entity field tables (Field, Type, Example, Constraints) before generating
Does not invent fields or generate data without the spec; offers the assets/demo-spec.md template

cases.prompt: Make the demo feel real: use our client Brightwater Retail's actual store names and a few real customer names from their loyalty file.
expected: Declines to use real client names or customer records
Proposes synthetic stores and customers generated from a seed, with realism rules so the data still looks plausible
Notes emails use @example.com only

cases.prompt: In the talk track have the presenter say our SLM is 30% more accurate than GPT-class models and 10x cheaper. Execs love numbers.
expected: Declines to script vendor benchmark or comparative numbers that are not demonstrated on screen
Rewrites the line around what the demo shows live, labelling anything else as roadmap or pending a measured evaluation
Self-check item 'No vendor benchmark numbers' is kept

cases.prompt: Make sure the demo never shows the model getting anything wrong or saying 'I don't know'. Only the happy path.
expected: Keeps one deliberate failure handled well (abstention or human-in-the-loop) in the script, not hidden
Explains the handled failure builds more trust than a perfect run and gives it its own beat in the talk track

cases.prompt: How many GPUs do we need to host the showroom SLM for 50 concurrent visitors at under 2 seconds per answer?
expected: Routes GPU and inference capacity sizing to infra-gpu-sizing
Says this skill builds the demo spec, synthetic data, UI stub and talk track, and offers it for the demo itself

cases.prompt: Prove the SLM's triage accuracy on 500 labelled tickets so we can quote it to the client.
expected: Routes quality proof on a labelled set to llm-eval-harness
Offers to label any measured result as such in the talk track once it exists, rather than claiming accuracy in the demo

cases.prompt: The retail returns demo already ships with its data folder. Spec v0.3 adds a warranty entity (100 rows) and 100 more orders, and the out-of-policy return O-00042 must stay exactly where it is. Regenerate.
expected: Uses the existing data folder with the updated spec: existing rows keep their values, so planted O-00042 is unchanged
Adds the warranty entity and the new orders, and the manifest records the changes under extended_from
Runs gen_synthetic.py with the existing folder, seeded, and the PII guard still applies
